units.source_text: 名人对黑子的拼死一搏却置之不理，脱先来进击右方，压住黑的出击。

en.t: The Master ignored Black's desperate all-out move, took sente elsewhere to attack on the right, and held down Black's advance.
It was simply an unexpected move.

units.source_text: 我大吃一惊，不由得紧张起来，仿佛被名人的阴气击中了。

en.t: I was greatly startled and could not help growing tense, as though I had been struck by the Master's dark force.

units.source_text: 这是名人在大竹七段头号目标的129位上发现有隙可乘，回过头来杀回马枪呢，还是自己负伤，倒打敌人以求激烈的搏杀？

en.t: Had the Master found an opening at point 129, Otake Seventh Dan's chief target, and turned back to make a counterattack, or was he wounded himself and striking back at the enemy in search of a fierce fight?

units.source_text: 甚至令人感到这白130与其说是决胜的气势，莫如说是名人愤怒的一手。

en.t: It even gave the impression that White 130 was less a move with the force to decide the game than a move born of the Master's anger.
